unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Systems of rational equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: A solution of a system of rational equations in two unknowns is a pair (x; y) satisfying every equation of the system.
stages.headlineEnglish: A solution of a system of rational equations in two unknowns is a pair (x; y) satisfying every equation of the system.

stages.headline: To solve a system means to find all its solutions or show there are none; this one has two: (2; 3) and (3; 2).
stages.headlineEnglish: To solve a system means to find all its solutions or show there are none; this one has two: (2; 3) and (3; 2).

stages.headline: The main methods are substitution, addition, new variables and graphs.
stages.headlineEnglish: The main methods are substitution, addition, new variables and graphs.
